name: Disney's live-action Moana
description: Hawaiian's Pualani scheme (the 'HAWAIIAN' title over the forward windows, the gray lei, the magenta flowers and purple aft fuselage, Pualani on the purple-to-magenta fin) with Disney's live-action 'Moana' artwork laid over the middle and aft fuselage on both sides: blue ocean swirls, Maui as a hawk and his great fishhook, the Kakamora; 'VOYAGE BEYOND THE REEF' in two lines of blue serif capitals under the forward windows; Disney's 'Moana' title on the engines; Heihei and Pua on the wingtips. On the A321neo N227HA, the first of three designs.

sources.note: The first on the A321neo N227HA, unveiled 2026-06-11; an A330 and a 717 to follow in July 2026 (not named). The artwork's contents.

logos.description: Pualani ('flower of the sky'): a Hawaiian woman's face and neck in profile in white, facing forward and a little up with a calm slight smile. Her deep indigo hair is drawn back from the forehead and falls down her back off the trailing edge. A red hibiscus with a dark heart sits behind her ear and runs off the trailing edge too. Mirrored on the right side.

Disney's 'Moana' artwork over the middle and aft fuselage on both sides, from just behind the second door to the magenta flowers ahead of the purple, mostly above the windows and across them: blue ocean swirls, Maui as a hawk, his fishhook, the Kakamora riding the sea breeze. Disney's characters, painted under licence: not drawn here.
Disney's 'Moana' title (the 'Disney' script over 'MOANA' in blue, the O a spiral) on each nacelle. Disney's mark: not drawn here.
Heihei the rooster and Pua the pig on the wingtips (sharklets), per the airline. Disney's characters: not drawn here.

titles.style: Widely spaced, upright medium-weight capitals in purple, over the forward windows behind the door.
Blue serif capitals, the first of two centered lines under the windows beneath 'HAWAIIAN'.
The second line, centered under the first.

notes: Hawaiian's own paint round the artwork is the standard scheme's (HAL/standard), measured there on N208HA; the airline's press photos of N227HA (June 2026) show it unchanged: the title, the lei and flowers round and behind the artwork, the aft purple, the fin. New here, measured on press photo -23 against the 'HAWAIIAN' title (its ends fix the scale; a view from ahead and above, so low confidence on heights): 'VOYAGE BEYOND THE REEF' and where the artwork runs. The artwork, Disney's, stays a licensed logo, not drawn; where it covers the fuselage the drawing shows the airline's white and lei under it. Both sides carry the artwork (press photo -16, the right side aft). No openly licensed photo of N227HA in the paint yet (Commons' newest is 2025-03). The A330 and 717 designs announced for July 2026 are other designs, not seen in any source that names the jets: not drawn (leads N381HA, N479HA). How long the jets keep the paint isn't announced.
history: The third Hawaiian-Disney Moana promotion, after 'Moana' (2016) and 'Moana 2' (three jets from 2024-10-28, through March 2025). Unveiled 2026-06-11 at Honolulu, a month before the film's release on 2026-07-10.
